System

Authentication boundaries, abuse prevention and privacy

Treat every network request as untrusted input. Authenticate identity at admission, validate ownership at every command and fence stale server sessions before they can write durable state. Security is a continuing process, not a claim that a dedicated server prevents cheating.

Scope and player interaction

Treat every network request as untrusted input. Authenticate identity at admission, validate ownership at every command and fence stale server sessions before they can write durable state. Security is a continuing process, not a claim that a dedicated server prevents cheating.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase03committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

AdmissionPending → Authenticated → RateLimited → Rejected → SessionRevoked → Maintenance

WBP_Diagnostics observes results from URPGAdmissionValidator. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_SecurityPolicy_Development. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
AccountId/CharacterId: from validated identity mapping, never a trusted payload claim
SessionEpoch and LeaseOwner: backend-issued fencing values
CommandId/RequestHash: replay key with payload binding
RateLimitBuckets: action family, character/account and IP defense-in-depth
AllowedProtocol/CatalogVersions: exact compatibility set
AuditRetentionDays: documented policy requiring jurisdictional review; no invented compliance certification

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGAdmissionValidatorImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DiagnosticsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
ValidateAdmission(Ticket, ConnectionContext) -> AuthorizedIdentity|TicketExpired|Forbidden
ValidateCommandEnvelope(Envelope, AuthenticatedSession) -> Valid|StaleSession|RateLimited
RevokeSession(CharacterId, Reason) -> RevokedEpoch
ReportAbuse(TargetIdentity, Category, EvidenceReferences) -> ReportId|RateLimited

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Backend verifies provider issuer/audience/signature/expiry/nonce and resolves a stable account identity. EOS is an optional provider interface, not the character database.
  2. Zone verifies a one-use admission ticket bound to account, character, destination and protocol; do not pass bearer credentials through ordinary logged command-line URLs.
  3. Each command checks current actor ownership, live state/range/rate and payload bounds; durable writes additionally require the current epoch and expected revision.
  4. Backend uses parameterized SQL, narrow service credentials and server-side catalog validation; reject negative quantities, arithmetic overflow and unknown item IDs.
  5. Rate-limited/rejected requests return stable reason codes, not secret details. Repeated impossible actions produce auditable signals for review rather than automatic punishment based on one lag spike.
  6. Operational staff can revoke sessions and investigate ledger/command IDs under least privilege; logs exclude passwords, tokens, private message contents unless retention policy explicitly permits protected moderation evidence.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Configure development authentication only for loopback/private environments and make production service startup fail when the fixture provider is selected.
  2. Create two service credentials: zone mutation/admission capability and administrative migration/backup capability; never package either in client assets.
  3. Reopen BP_ZoneGameMode admission path so unauthorized connections cannot possess a pawn before validation completes.
  4. Add request-size/count limits and per-command cooldown/rate checks in native handlers; expose diagnostics counters read-only to WBP_Diagnostics in development builds.
  5. Create malicious request fixtures for other-character IDs, stale epochs, duplicate command IDs with changed payloads, oversized chat and negative quantities.
  6. Write privacy, deletion, retention and support-contact policies for the actual deployment jurisdiction before public accounts; obtain appropriate review rather than claiming this manual is legal advice.

Reopen Phase03 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_NetworkLab / forged-client test harness / isolated backend fixture. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Old zone sends inventory mutation after handoff -> StaleSession with zero rows changed.
Forged AccountId or item GUID -> Forbidden; no data disclosure.
Same command ID with changed amount -> IdempotencyConflict; do not return a receipt for a different payload.
Fast movement under high latency -> inspect movement correction history and approved modes before sanctions.
SQL metacharacters in name -> treated as data and validated; no SQL execution.
Leaked/rotated zone credential -> revoke and renew service identity; do not require rebuilding all clients.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Propose a 10 requests/second economic-command ceiling with a small burst allowance in the development fixture, then tune from real interaction patterns. Network movement uses engine cadence, not that economic limiter.

Correlate account pseudonymous ID, character, epoch, command, outcome, latency and abuse rule. Publish retention boundaries and support escalation; no credentials in screenshots or crash reports.
